title: Respiratory Protective Devices - Half Masks And Quarter Masks
clause_1_scope: This standard prescribes requirements for half masks and quarter masks for use as part of respiratory protective devices, except escape apparatus and diving apparatus. Laboratory and practical performance tests are included for the assessment of compliance with the requirements.
